keyFeature: Customer service platform with the Fin AI agent

profile.headline: A customer service platform with a helpdesk and the Fin AI Agent

capabilities.title: Let an AI agent handle conversations
capabilities.text: Fin AI Agent is trained on your knowledge, processes and policies and works across phone, email, chat and Slack.

capabilities.title: Work in one inbox
capabilities.text: The Intercom helpdesk has an omnichannel inbox with Copilot alongside the human team.

capabilities.title: Test before going live
capabilities.text: AI-driven Simulations run multi-step conversations before Fin talks to customers.

capabilities.title: Get approval inside a conversation
capabilities.text: Fin can ask a teammate for approval or information, such as before a refund reply, and then finish the conversation.

featureCards.name: Copilot 2 in the Inbox
featureCards.text: Works before the team asks, connects to existing tools and handles admin tasks.

featureCards.name: Ticketing built for collaboration
featureCards.text: Covers customer issues, back-office work and tracker tickets for widespread problems.

featureCards.name: Knowledge Hub
featureCards.text: One place for the content that powers Fin, human agents and self-serve support.

featureCards.name: Auto-translation
featureCards.text: Translates customer conversations, shown with a Spanish example.

featureCards.name: Product tours and checklists
featureCards.text: In-context messages that onboard, educate and notify customers.

featureCards.name: Integrations
featureCards.text: Tools such as Slack, Shopify and GitHub, with Fin acting through APIs or MCP.

audienceDetail.text: The main audience, with companies such as Anthropic, Clay and Lightspeed named.
Product tours and onboarding checklists are part of the helpdesk.

scenarios.title: Troubleshoot a sign-in problem
scenarios.text: Fin works on a desktop app sign-in issue before handing off to a person.

scenarios.title: Handle address change requests
scenarios.text: Customers follow progress with a ticket status card.

scenarios.title: Guide new users
scenarios.text: Product tours and checklists, shown with a banking app example.

scenarios.title: Reply across languages
scenarios.text: Translate a Spanish-language conversation inside the inbox.

gettingStarted.step: Start a free trial or view the demo
gettingStarted.text: The page says the trial lasts 14 days and needs no credit card.
Use your knowledge, processes and policies, and test with Simulations.
The site shows a combined seat and per-outcome price, with spending limits, and a sales contact.
